Name: TrueClock
Author: regivaldorfs
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]

True Clock adds a real-world clock to the Stardew Valley HUD, so you can keep track of your local time without leaving the game. The clock uses your computer’s current time, not the in-game Stardew Valley time.
The mod also includes configurable real-time alerts, useful for reminders while playing.
Installation instructions
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download the latest [b]TrueClock.zip[/b][/*]
[*]Extract the ZIP file into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods folder[/b].[/*]
[*]Make sure the folder structure looks like this:[/*]
[/list][code]Stardew Valley/
  Mods/
    TrueClock/
      manifest.json
      TrueClock.dll
      i18n/[/code][list=1]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]On first launch, the mod will create a [size=2][font=Monaco, Menlo, Consolas, monospace][b]config.json [/b][/font][/size]file inside the [size=2][font=Monaco, Menlo, Consolas, monospace][b]TrueClock [/b][/font][/size]folder.

[size=4]Main features[/size]
[list]
[*]Shows your real local time directly on the in-game HUD.[/*]
[*]Uses Stardew Valley’s native UI style.[/*]
[*]Supports both 24-hour and AM/PM time formats.[/*]
[*]Includes up to five configurable real-time alerts.[/*]
[*]Each alert can be enabled or disabled individually.[/*]
[*]Alerts can include a custom message.[/*]
[*]Alerts show a small HUD message and a clock balloon above the player.[/*]
[*]Includes a short alarm sound when an alert triggers.[/*]
[*]Optional support for Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[/list][size=4]Requirements[/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer[/*]
[/list][size=4]Optional:[/size]
[list]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu, if you want to configure the mod through an in-game settings menu.[/*]
[/list]Without Generic Mod Config Menu, you can edit the generated [size=2][font=Monaco, Menlo, Consolas, monospace][b]config.json [/b][/font][/size]file manually.

[size=4]Shout outs[/size]
Thanks to the SMAPI team and the Stardew Valley modding community for the tools, documentation, and examples that make mods like this possible.
Special thanks to ConcernedApe for creating Stardew Valley.
